title: palicourea leiantha
intro: Palicourea leiantha, commonly known as Brazilian guianensis or palicourea, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea leiantha include its ability to treat fever, headache, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential in treating certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
